Title: Open Register Page
Expected Result: Register page loads and registration form is visible

Title: Required Fields Validation
Expected Result: Show validation errors / required field messages or page rejects submission
Notes: If site doesn't show inline errors

Title: Valid Registration
Steps:
1. Fill all mandatory fields with valid data (unique username)
2. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: Registration success message with username shown

Title: Invalid Email Format
Steps:
1. Enter invalid email (e.g., 'user-at-example') in Email field
2. Fill other required fields
3. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: Form rejects submission or shows email format error

Title: Password Mismatch
Steps:
1. Enter different values in Password and Confirm Password
2. Fill other required fields
3. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: Form rejects submission or shows password mismatch error

Title: Minimum Field Lengths
Steps:
1. Enter very short values in First/Last name and username
2. Fill other fields
3. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: Either accept or show validation; record constraints

Title: Country Dropdown
Steps:
1. Open Country dropdown
2. Select a country (e.g., 'UNITED STATES')
Expected Result: Selected country is set in the form
Notes: Verify value submitted in success page

Title: Special Characters in Username
Steps:
1. Use username with special chars (e.g., 'user!@#')
2. Fill other fields
3. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: Check if registration accepted or rejected

Title: Duplicate Username
Steps:
1. Use an existing username
2. Fill other fields
3. Click 'Submit'
Notes: May require manual setup of existing username

Title: Contact Fields Persistence
Steps:
1. Fill contact fields (Phone, Email)
2. Refresh page or navigate back to Register
3. Re-open Register page
Expected Result: Fields should be empty or persisted depending on expected behavior
